newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News Ltd appoints Lachlan Murdoch MD.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News Ltd appoints Lachlan Murdoch MD.

text.p: News Ltd, the Australian unit of News Corp Ltd, said on Monday it has appointed Lachlan Murdoch to the position of managing director, effective immediately.

News Ltd chairman and chief executive Ken Cowley said in a statement: "I will remain intimately in the business as executive chairman of News Limited as well as continuing to hold a range of directorships."

"My primary function will be to shape the strategic direction of the group's businesses at a time when traditional media is confronting its greatest challenges from technological change and increased competition," Cowley said.
"Lachlan will concentrate on managing the News group operations and will report to me," he said. Lachlan Murdoch is the son of Rupert Murdoch, chairman of News Corp.
Lachlan joined News Ltd in 1994 as general manager of Queensland Newspapers and was promoted to deputy managing director of News Ltd.
"My progress through News Limited has been made possible because of the support of Mr Cowley and the other executives of the News group," Lachlan Murdoch said in the same statement.

A News Ltd spokesperson said Lachlan would be fufilling the role held by Bob Muscat, who was chief operating officer at News Ltd before leaving to join rival newspaper group John Fairfax Holdings Ltd.
Cowley said he would also continue as a director of News Corporation and as a member of News Corporation's international executive committee.
The spokesperson later said Lachlan would have wider responsibilities beyond News Ltd's main newspaper businesses in Australia.
News Ltd has a 50 percent interest in airline Ansett television joint venture as well as a controlling interest in Pacific Magazines and Publishing Ltd.
